notes.title: Punch Club 2: Fast Forward is coming in 2023!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10070251/2b24182ea2993056aee55aada2f5ce2b2094d537.png[/img]

In the not-too-distant future (or a parallel universe altogether?!), there's a town that seems achingly familiar, where everything seems to be just as you remember it... but at the same time, things have changed drastically.

The streets are covered in neon, police holograms patrol neighborhoods, the gym has a new neuro fitness machine, and... Wait is that a Jedi robot massage therapist?! 

[h3][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1161590/ ]Wishlist Now![/url][/h3]
[b]Punch Club 2: Fast Forward[/b] - the smashing sequel to your favorite fighter management sim is making its way to[b] PC[/b] in [b]2023![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1161590/ 

[h3]Watch The New Trailer[/h3]
[previewyoutube=1OWPiHZOMEM;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]The Future Starts Now[/h3]
The game events take place in a dystopian cyberpunk future. You will once again take on the role of a fighter, but this time, not only will you have to fight your way to the championship, but you will also have to uncover the darkest secrets of your family! What a twist.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10070251/76384c91ce8c9ec9d76a3007e49e3524372c0c62.gif[/img]

[h3]Train And Fight Your Way[/h3]
The city is full of events and gangs ( or, well, 'fighting schools', call them what you like). Work out at home with dumbbells or in the gym on a neuro trainer (what?), bend girders in a junkyard (what?), work in a slime-beating factory (what?), watch the 80s and 90s action movies (oh yeah!) and fight your way to the top.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10070251/d8e7e4adc29f00ee7b8ae18a4cfe94d4109ddf40.gif[/img]

Prepare to witness an unforgettable story, fully loaded with humor and references to the 80-90s and set in the atmosphere of a cyberpunk future. Unique locations and characters, all in the form of gorgeous pixel art dream graphics, await you.

notes.title: The Dark Fist out now! No, Fluffy, nooo
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/C3KiBJJ.gif[/img]

Punch Club The Dark Fist expansion is now live, and part of your main game! Expect new things to happen on ±day 6. 

We genuinely can't wait for you guys to play it. The team at LazyBear have done a phenomenal job with this content expansion, and it's a way for us to thank you -- our fans -- for being awesome!

[h1]3 Hours Of New Content -- you need to start a new game[/h1]

Yes, you will get to figure out what happens to Fluffy the cat. And yes there is a whole side-story to this. We definitely didn't just forget to put the sprite into the new house and made this all up. Search for a briefcase in your house on around day 6. 

[list][*]You need to start a new game
[*]New content appears on about day 6
[*]Search for the briefcase in your house[/list]

[h1]Hardcore Mode[/h1]

We love how you guys figure the game out, and do very specific builds to speedrun through Punch Club. But can you handle Hardcore Mode? Your opponents level up alongside you ;) 

[h1]Cloud Saves![/h1]

Yes, you are finally able to cloud-save. The mobile versions are getting the Cloud update this Thursday, so you can start playing now and then continue on your phones or vice-versa. 

[h1]Expanded main theme[/h1]

The main theme has been expanded and can be heard in this teaser trailer:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8XAxsT5XwVw

[h1]New Languages![/h1]

We've added Chinese, Japanese, and Italian languages

[h1]Twitch Integration[/h1]

The game now has Twitch Integration, and you should be super excited -- by watching your favorite streamer play Punch Club, you can now place bets during fights. You can spend winning points in our tinyRewards program.

Enjoy!

[h1]PS Spoiler Warning![/h1]

Please be cautious about spoilers when you beat the story. We will be banning people from the forum who spoil the story, let everyone experience it properly.

Doing a free content update to a game that's not Early Access!

Announcing The Dark Fist - a new and exciting expansion for Punch Club that is completely free, adds 3 hours of content, and a ton of bulletpoint-worthy features!

notes.title: Android coming on Jan 28, future plans reveal
notes.content:
Fantastic news everyone! We've seen lots of anticipation for an Android build and now we have a date. 

Punch Club will launch on Google Play on January 28th. We will support devices with portrait width of 640 and over. Not making guarantees on a huge number of supported devices, but will do our best. 

[h1]Reflecting on the launch.[/h1]

Mike wrote an extensive post mortem on the first hectic days of the launch. You can read it on [url=http://www.polygon.com/2016/1/14/10767458/we-made-a-livestream-ignored-the-press-and-created-a-successful-indie]Polygon[/url]. That sums up the chaos we experienced here. Between sleeping in shifts, panic-calling Valve to “HEY THE GAME IS BEATEN WE NEED TO LAUNCH”, coaching the Twitch Plays community on how to beat it effectively… it’s been weird! This is also in conjunction with preparing for PAX South. Which is a fulltime job.

I’m very happy with the launch, so thanks everyone for the support!

[h1]PAX South – Win Exclusive T-Shirts![/h1]

At PAX South we will be giving away exclusive T-Shirts that you can win by punching really hard! Come by to our super orange booth.

[h1]iOS Update coming very soon[/h1]

Expect an iOS update very soon to match with the Steam version

[h1]Major content update in the works![/h1]

A ton of stuff didn’t get into the release version of Punch Club. This will be fixed. A large content update is in the works, adding additional story. It will take about a month and will be awesome.

[h1]You want consoles?[/h1]

We’ll talk about that very soon!

notes.title: Version 1.03 - Lots of changes to the late game mechanics
notes.content:
[list]
  [*] MAJOR bug fix: ranked fights fame rewards don't work and grinding to unlock the next fighter was insane. So, we removed fame rewards, but re-balanced unlock values to make it easier to get the next fight. More details here: http://steamcommunity.com/app/394310/discussions/1/458605613410723514/
  [*] Mechanics forced players to farm ninjas over and over again. So, we added 2-day cooldown for movie/gangsters fights.
  [*] Movie/gangster fighters were re-balanced a bit to be more challenging and not so easy to farm.
  [*] Also, we reduced the time of party/poker/etc. actions to make earning fame more simple.
  [*] Removed unnecessary "Manage your career / cancel" selection when clicking on the manager.
  [*] Made new skill price cap. New skills can't cost more then 25 SP now.
  [*] Fixed a bug causing wrong positions of a [...] icon in some dialogs.
[/list]

notes.title: Clarification on the release date for Punch Club
notes.content:
Hey guys! We wanted to offer a clarification on the release date for Punch Club, as a number of users appear to have been confused by how we've worded it. Apologies for that! Here's the situation in a nutshell:

- You can currently pre-order Punch Club if you wish on the Steam page
- Those pre-orders will unlock when "Twitch Plays Punch Club" manages to beat the game, as found here: http://www.twitch.tv/twitchplayspunchclub
- At the latest, the game will launch on January 25 if Twitch hasn't beaten the game by then (but we're pretty sure they will have)
- When Twitch beats Punch Club (or by January 25), the game will become available to purchase and play on Steam.

If anyone has pre-ordered the game, and didn't understand any of this, we're sorry about that! Feel free to ask for a refund. This is all for a bit of fun, so we obviously don't want people getting upset about something that's meant to be fun.

[And apologies for the convoluted post before this one. We're so tired. When can we sleep. Please let us sleep.] 

[h1]As a bonus, we will add ourselves as enemies in the game. So you can beat us up.[/h1]

notes.title: How the game benefits from Twitch Plays
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

I wanted to spend a minute to talk about how Punch Club will benefit from the whole Twitch Plays experiment. In the midst of this crazy launch (currently just around 1k people playing at http://www.twitch.tv/twitchplayspunchclub ) we forgot to mention one important thing. 

The game isn't done yet. Before it gets pushed live we are doing an important balancing update which is based on everything we're seeing in the Twitch Plays Punch Club livestream. 

This includes balancing of the progression system, enemies, and random events that happen.  

[h1]SPOILERS BELOW! Can't talk about specific game design things without spoiling some of the story[/h1]

Back in October we started beta testing (as you can see in earlier forum posts), and the first 3 hours of Punch Club were incredibly fun. Then, after an important plot point, we saw people losing interest. It became a grinder game and wasn't as fun. 

So we started to add-on more mechanics. These include the random events like going out to bars, having to manage your social life (your girlfriend) and also the late game events. 

With the closed betas we were able to get the game to 95% of where it needs to be. Now, we're sitting watching the chat play, and realizing what kind of moments players will enjoy most -- figuring out ways for them to happen more often. Adding so much content late in the game's development cycle, coupled with a very tight schedule, makes testing incredibly difficult. 

We're also cautious about players getting stuck. In these style of games, it's important for the player not to end up in an endless loop. So if anyone can get stuck, it's the Twitch chat. 

I take responsibility for unclear initial communication, as it could seem to some that the game was out, and then wasn't. This, in combination with lack of explanation on the pre-launch update, can make us come off as some evil game company. 

We're going to add ourselves in the game as NPCs that you can beat up. 

[H1]What if Twitch never beats the game?[/h1]

While this is very unlikely, our plan B is to play the game ourselves in the chat and make sure it doesn't release later than January 25th -- aligning with PAX South.

notes.title: Version 0.86 uploaded - some major balance changes
notes.content:
We've made some balance changes that will make your leveling-up more comfortable and stats drop not so hard. But this affected your level, so if you were level 10, your current level will be around 7 (as well as your opponents!). And that's actually good ;)

ver. 0.86
[list]
[*] Some major re-balancing. Changed the STR/AGL/STM gross curve. What does it mean? It means that previously if you had 1000 internal strength points, you had 10 level of strength (every level costed 100 points). Now every next level requires more points, so 1000 points gives you level 7. So, your saved character will lose the level number (as you opponents). But actually it is good. Because you will not lose so much levels every day.
[*] Increased skill points rewards for winning.
[*] Now it is impossable to grind Silver for skill points (the fights are limited for each day).
[*] Changed the order of some skills in the skill tree (you may experience some weird issues loading your previous savegame).
[*] Opponents re-balancing.
[*] Fixed a bunch of bugs.
[*] Some GUI improvements.
[/list]
